about.title: Advancing Research, Developing Skills Worldwide
about.intro: The Global Institute of Research & Skills Development (GIRSD) is an international institute registered in the United Kingdom, uniting scholars, educators, and industry leaders across 50+ countries.
about.mission: To advance research excellence and practical professional capability through high-impact international conferences, accredited learning, and global collaboration.
about.vision: To be the foremost global platform connecting academic research with practical employability, innovation, and international recognition.

founder.name: Dr Chandrakumar
founder.affiliation: Q TECH PRIVATE LTD, trading as GIRSD
founder.bio: Dr Chandrakumar founded GIRSD with a conviction that rigorous research and practical skills development belong together. With a doctorate in engineering management and fifteen years spanning academia and industry consultancy, he has organised international conferences across three continents.

membership.title: Join a Distinguished Worldwide Academic Community
membership.intro: Connect with scholars, educators and professionals across 50+ countries. Enjoy 10% savings on conference tickets and 5% on courses, post-nominal designations, and exclusive mentorship opportunities.

tiers.name: Fellow (FGIRSD)
tiers.description: For senior academics, professors, researchers with 10+ years experience, and institutional leaders.
perks: 10% discount on conferences and 5% on courses

tiers.name: Member (MGIRSD)
tiers.description: For practicing researchers, lecturers, and industry professionals.

tiers.name: Student & Early-Career
tiers.description: For doctoral candidates, master's students, and researchers within 3 years of qualification.

internships.title: Global Research & Skills Internships
internships.intro: Gain real project experience, work alongside international mentors, and earn UK CPD accredited certificates.
perks: UK CPD Standards Office accredited certificate
Flexible remote engagement across international time zones
